cpa_source: ESTIMATED. regulatory_note: OUT OF SCOPE per CLAUDE.md section 2 (supplements, ingestibles, health claims). If ever reconsidered: brand on label is the distributor of record; structure/function claims need substantiation, FDA notice within 30 days of marketing and the DSHEA disclaimer (fda.gov structure/function page, updated 2024-03-28); FTC requires competent and reliable scientific evidence, generally RCTs (FTC Health Products Compliance Guidance, Dec 2022); serious adverse event reports to FDA within 15 business days for the name on the label; Amazon and TikTok Shop require ISO 17025 third-party testing via approved TIC bodies (secondary sources 2026; TikTok supplements reported invite-only); Meta health and wellness rules can block Purchase-event optimization (vendor reports since early 2025). delivery_days: 1-2 business days to pick, then USPS Priority 3-5 or UPS Ground 3-7 business days (rocktomic.com/how-it-works)

name: Hyaluronic acid serum 30 ml (Blanka)
model: 2 own-brand skincare, US maker labels and ships each order
cpa_source: ESTIMATED. Meta median cost per purchase, Beauty, Triple Whale Aug 2025-Jul 2026 (triplewhale.com/blog/facebook-ads-benchmarks; page blocked, value from snippets, same as data/channel_params.json). Higher alternative: $51.45 median, 12 beauty brands, MHI Media agency clients, 29 Oct 2025-28 Oct 2026 (mhigrowthengine.com/blog/average-cost-per-acquisition-by-dtc-vertical-2026). TikTok ads Beauty median CPA $10.32 but median ROAS 0.46 (Triple Whale via sovran.ai, checked 2026-09-29), so TikTok platform CPA looks unreliable as a planning figure.
repeat_source: ESTIMATED. Cosmetics 25.9% of customers buy again (StoreGrowers figure quoted by eightx.co/blog/average-repeat-purchase-rate-by-vertical, Jun 2026; partly traces to Metrilo 2019 data, so OLDER). Vendor ranges for beauty run 30-40%/yr, strong brands 40-55% (same page; reotter.com, thedtcplaybook.com 2026). Use 0.26 low, 0.40 high.
regulatory_note: Cosmetic under MoCRA: we are the responsible person if our name is on the label. Serious adverse events to FDA within 15 business days; keep safety substantiation records; label needs US contact for AE reports; product listing and facility registration (the maker registers the facility). Small businesses (average gross sales under about $1M/yr over 3 years, inflation-adjusted; exact current figure UNKNOWN) are exempt from listing, registration and future GMP rules but NOT from AE reporting, safety substantiation or labeling, and the exemption is lost for eye-area, injected, internal or 24h+ appearance products (fda.gov MoCRA page, updated 2026-10-29). Avoid anything with SPF or acne/drug claims (OTC drug). Insurance about $1,000-3,000/yr (Insurance Canopy and other brokers, 2026).
supplier: Blanka (fulfils from Farmers Branch, Dallas TX)
fulfil_note: No per-order fulfilment fee listed; shipping is flat.
ship_note: Flat $9.99 standard, $29.99 expedited per US customer order (faq.blankabrand.com/en/articles/4880229, updated 2026-08-18). Published rate.
monthly_fee_note: Free $0 (3 products); Essentials $39/mo or $26 yearly (25 products); Signature $79; VIP $149 (blankabrand.com/pricing, 2026-11-19). Whether Free allows branded fulfilment UNKNOWN. Logo design $500 optional.
delivery_days: Branded made-to-order: 5-9 business days to produce (2-5 on VIP) plus 3-5 days transit = about 8-14 business days. Stored inventory ships in 1-2 days. (faq.blankabrand.com, updated 2026-03-31). On-demand FAILS the CLAUDE.md 2-8 business day rule unless stock is held at Blanka.
minimum: No MOQ for dropship; custom formulas 500 units
vendor_bias: Vendor public price list; 'profit' figures are vendor suggested retail.
unit_cost_source: Blanka public product price (cost to brand), 5-15% off at 12+ units. Not a quote.
